name: Rebecca Stone
message: Hello, I run a small event agency with six people. We organise corporate events and weddings, and honestly our process is chaos. Client requests arrive by email, we track tasks in Trello, budgets live in Google Sheets, and contracts are saved somewhere in Drive. The biggest problem is vendor confirmations: we ask caterers, florists and venues to confirm by a certain date, and about once a month someone forgets to follow up, which has caused real problems. I would love a system that reminds us about open vendor confirmations and deadlines and gives me a weekly overview per event. I am not technical at all, so it has to be simple. Is this something you could help with?

name: Patrick Dubois
message: Good afternoon. We import wine from France and Italy and sell to restaurants in Germany and Austria. Our inventory is still in an old FileMaker database that only one person understands, and she is retiring next year. Supplier emails arrive in French and Italian with price lists as PDF or Excel attachments, and prices change every few months. We also invoice in euros but sometimes buy in other currencies. I am not sure where to even start: replace the database, or first automate how we process supplier price lists and inventory counts? We have about 400 products and 25 regular suppliers. Any advice on a sensible first step would be appreciated.
